Messages.Author: Emmit Svenson
Messages.Body:
If another Methuselah takes control of a Mummy and the Mummy is
subsequently burned, whose library is the Mummy shuffled into: the
current controller's or the original controller's?

Messages.Author: Flux
Messages.Body:
Emmit Svenson <emmits...@hotmail.com> wrote in message
news:75bdf7ed.01071...@posting.google.com...

> If another Methuselah takes control of a Mummy and the Mummy is
> subsequently burned, whose library is the Mummy shuffled into: the
> current controller's or the original controller's?

From the online rulings list:

Cards that go into an ash heap, hand, or library always go into their
owner's ash heap, hand, or library. [RTR 19970425]

Flux

Messages.Author: Roger Carhult
Messages.Body:
"Flux" <fl...@netc.pt> wrote in message news:<G9057.39024$Ag6.55...@newsserver.ip.pt>...


What if I graverob a vampire and then commit diablerie with it and
it's burned in the Blood Hunt. Then the vampire would go to owner's
ash heap, but if the owner has already been ousted, does that mean I
can't daamonic possess the vampire back to me?

Same question for a Meth who's ousted, his minions are considered
burned. But I can't daemonic possess them since they're out of play,
right?

Messages.Author: James Coupe
Messages.Body:
In message <1b3db623.01071...@posting.google.com>, Roger
Carhult <rogc...@student.luth.se> writes

>What if I graverob a vampire and then commit diablerie with it and
>it's burned in the Blood Hunt. Then the vampire would go to owner's
>ash heap,

Correct.

> but if the owner has already been ousted,

Then the ash heap is no longer around for taking cards from etc.

>does that mean I
>can't daamonic possess the vampire back to me?

You controlled the vampire anyway, so couldn't target it.

>Same question for a Meth who's ousted, his minions are considered
>burned. But I can't daemonic possess them since they're out of play,
>right?

Right. But the grave-robbed vampire wasn't one of his controlled
minions when it burned.
